text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — smart-routing detected repeated cross-region failover loop between us-east, us-west, eu (healthcheck flips). Auto-fallback triggered 18 times in last 3m. Paging on-call.

infra-bot: detected abnormal health delta: us-west probe failure -> immediate fallback to us-east, then eu reports degraded, then us-west becomes healthy again, loop. Probable symptom: transient KV cache OOM + model-variant mismatch on us-west.

maria: I'm on it. Adding context: service `inference-router` smart-fallback policy has `circuit_breaker: auto` + `prefetch_probe: on` for this customer tier.

jon: seeing spike in 5xxs for sessions routed back-and-forth. Customer-facing latency up ~450ms P90 and error rate up 3.4% cluster-wide. Which customers impacted?

ashley: quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE region IN ('us-east','us-west','eu') AND error=1 AND ts > now()-5m;` returns ~12.3k failed attempts, mostly small-batch chat endpoints. Top 3 tenants: alpha-dash, shopio, metricsly.

samir: on-call handoff — paging luca. @luca-oncall you're assigned. Recommended immediate mitigation: pause smart fallback policy for 5m, and set healthcheck debounce to 12s.

luca-oncall: ack. I'm going to disable region auto-fallback for `inference-router` globally for now (will fail closed to primary region). Taking current action.

ops-bot: Executing: `platformctl routing update inference-router --fallback-policy=disabled --note="hotfix-disabling-auto-fallback-1749994321"`

ops-bot: Done. Fallback policy disabled. New routing policy applied to control-plane in 15s.

lee: after disabling fallback, traffic stabilizing? Telemetry shows fewer cross-region handoffs but us-west still showing intermittent health-probe flaps.

maria: digging into probe logs from us-west — healthcheck failures are `KVCache OOM` followed by model process restart. There's also a recent model variant rollout for `serie-b-3q` in us-west yesterday.

jon: can we confirm whether the model variant in us-west is compatible with current runtime kernel selection? If a variant triggers higher memory use that could produce probe failures.

samir: grab the deploy diff: `git rev-list --patch origin/main..deploys/us-west/serie-b-3q` shows quantization flags changed: `use_async_kv=true` and `large_attention_chunking=true`. That may increase transient memory.

ashley: good find. Operator process shows repeated logs: 
```
runtime: kv-cache allocate failed: out of memory
worker: oom killer invoked, restart
healthcheck: probe fail (code 503)
```

samir: so OOM->restart->probe fail->fallback->route bounce -> probe sees primaries unhealthy -> bounce back -> repeat. Disabling fallback stops the bounce but doesn't remove the root cause.

luca-oncall: action items now: 1) Revert model variant flags in us-west OR roll traffic off us-west to a warm pool. 2) Increase healthcheck debounce and progressive backoff. 3) Notify customers and open incident ticket. Who can revert the variant?

maria: I can coordinate revert. Plan: roll back `serie-b-3q` in us-west to `serie-b-3p` (previous stable) via canary rollback command: `deployctl rollback --region us-west --service model-variant --to=serie-b-3p --reason="hotfix-1749994321"`. Doing that now, will proceed with 5% -> 25% -> 100% ramp if green.

ops-bot: Rollback started. Canary 5% at 1749994380. Monitoring.

jon: setting healthcheck debounce to 12s and consecutive failures threshold to 4 for regional probes to reduce sensitivity. Patch incoming to control plane: 
```
PATCH /config/probes/inference-router
{ debounce_seconds: 12, consecutive_failures: 4 }
```

ops-bot: Probe config updated across regions.

lee: telemetry: after rollback canary 5% we see error rate in us-west drop by 45% in 60s. KV OOM events decreased. Good sign.

maria: continuing rollout: moving to 25% at 1749994440. Monitoring logs for `kv-cache` errors.

samir: also enabling additional monitoring alerts: `kv-cache-oom` alert threshold lowered so we catch early but not oscillate.

luca-oncall: customer impact statement draft: "We observed intermittent increased errors and latency for a subset of customers between us-east / us-west / eu due to cascading health-probe failovers triggered by a model variant config change. We paused automatic fallback and rolled back the variant in us-west. Traffic restored and error rates improving. Postmortem to follow; mitigation action implemented at 1749994385 UTC." Thoughts?

jon: add note about affected tenants and compensation path. Also include timeline with exact timestamps.

maria: rollback to 100% complete at 1749994490. KV OOM events fell to baseline; healthchecks green across regions.

ops-bot: Autoscaling: triggered short-term scale-up of model workers in us-west +10% to soak traffic during rollout.

lee: can we re-enable fallback policy now or keep disabled for longer? My vote: keep disabled until postmortem and a canary test of fallback policy with throttle.

luca-oncall: Agreed. I'll leave fallback disabled and schedule a controlled test: enable fallback for 1% of traffic for 30m with strict debounce in 24h. Putting a ticket in INC-174999 to track.

samir: follow-ups: change runbook to include model-variant memory audit before cross-region rollout, add a preflight that runs memory-pressure simulation, and make fallback policy more conservative (exponential cooldown).

maria: I'm filing the incident ticket and will draft postmortem. Will include logs, deploy diff, timeline, impact numbers, and remediation steps.

luca-oncall: handoff: I'm still primary and will coordinate postmortem with infra on-call tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Thanks all.

pagerbot: Incident annotated: severity=P1, status=mitigated (fallback paused, rollback complete), incident_id=INC-174999, responders=[maria,luca-oncall,samir,jon].

jon: quick go-forward checklist in thread: 1) postmortem doc, 2) fallback policy default cooldown increase, 3) preflight model memory test, 4) tenant impact notices & credits, 5) runbook update.

ashley: I'll draft customer notices for alpha-dash, shopio, metricsly and hand to comms.

maria: closing notes: root cause = model-variant config change that increased transient memory usage causing KV-cache OOM -> probe flaps -> routing bounce. Primary mitigation = rollback + disabled fallback + probe debounce increased. Postmortem planned.

luca-oncall: closing incident in Slack thread for now. If anything flares, re-ping pagerbot. Good work folks :thumbsup:
